name: Claude Code
cross_check: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog — confirm the npm dist-tag has a matching changelog entry before syncing content
release_notes: Use the official changelog page directly; each entry there is already scoped to what shipped in that release.
gotchas: npm dist-tags.latest can land ahead of the changelog page by a few hours — cross-check before syncing content, not just the version number.

Two independent version numbers are tracked on this placemat: the template version (this page's own structure, bumped only on structural/visual redesigns) and the CC release version (content, updated on every sync). Only the CC release version drives the header's 'As of release' tag and the changelog's Content/Release sections.

The standalone claude-code-placemat repo used class="new" and an <!-- added:vX.Y.Z --> comment to mark recent items directly in index.html. That convention is gone — this template computes 'new' per visitor at runtime from changes.json (house AGENTS.md); never write class="new" into index.html.
JSON settings that only apply in managed/enterprise policy files belong in the 'Managed & Enterprise' group of the Settings (JSON) card, not in the general settings groups.
